Ask copy of charm.land/bubbletea/v2

Upstream:   https://github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea (module charm.land/bubbletea/v2)
Version:    v2.0.10
Module sum: h1:oolvo20VBpI0PfqE7iFjkZ1bx0WpmXGfnKz5Yldjq5o= (upstream v2.0.10; Ask go.sum had no entry before this copy)
License:    MIT (file LICENSE, unchanged)
Used by:    internal/tui and cmd/tui, through the replace line in the go.mod of the repository

What is here
  All non-test Go files of the module, go.mod, go.sum, LICENSE and one test file,
  renderer_patch_test.go, which guards the patch. The other upstream tests and the
  testdata folder are not copied. This folder is its own module: "go test ./..." from
  the repository root does not run it. Run: go -C third_party/bubbletea test ./...
  The test TestDependencyPins in internal/tui runs it as one of its subtests.

The changes
  One upstream file is changed. The other files equal v2.0.10.
  cursed_renderer.go  New field awaitingSizedView. resize sets it, render clears it, and
                    flush writes nothing while it is set (a closing flush always writes).
                    Without it, the renderer draws the previous view at the new size in the
                    time between a resize and the next view of the program. The program
                    draws that view for the old row and column counts, so the frame shows
                    wrong rows for one flush.

Why this copy is kept
  Upstream v2.0.10 has no resize guard. The alternate screen program resizes often (a
  window drag sends many size events), and the guard removes the flash of a wrong
  frame. The terminal restore on every end path (leave the alternate screen, show the
  cursor, mouse reporting off) is upstream behavior: no patch is needed for it.

Guard
  renderer_patch_test.go tests inside the module: a flush after a resize writes nothing,
  the next view is drawn, and a closing flush still writes.
  TestDependencyPins fails when the replace line or the Ultraviolet pin moves.

How to update
  1. Download the new upstream tag (go mod download charm.land/bubbletea/v2@TAG) and copy
     its non-test Go files, go.mod, go.sum and LICENSE into this folder.
  2. Apply the files of the patches folder again (patch -p1 from this folder; each is a
     diff against v2.0.10).
  3. Keep Ultraviolet at the pin of the root go.mod, or test the new commit with the
     resize scenarios and the golden tests first.
  4. Run: go -C third_party/bubbletea test ./... and go test ./internal/tui/... ./cmd/tui/...
  5. Drop this copy and the replace line when upstream has the same guard. Then remove
     the replace line in go.mod, delete this folder, add the go.sum lines of the
     module and update deps_pin_test.go.

History
  The first copy had a larger patch for inline mode: a full-width committed row, a cursor
  placed again after a commit, a commit that writes nothing on the alternate screen, the
  screen switch before a commit, and tea.ReplayInlineTranscript with InlineReplayResult.
  The interactive TUI moved to the alternate screen and has no consumer for these, so
  they were removed with the inline commit path.
